Eli Martinez: Hey y'all  I'm Eli, joining eng-ml today. First-day hello! Quick setup Qs: where's the VPN/how-to badge request? Also my laptop is Linux (Ubuntu 22.04)  any standard dotfiles or package lists to install? :wave:

Chris (DevEx): welcome Eli!! :tada: VPN/how-to pinned in #devex; badge requests go through People Ops (link pinned). For Ubuntu, we usually run the bootstrap script in dotfiles repo. Quick commands:
```bash
git clone https://git.redwood.internal/dotfiles.git ~/dotfiles
~/dotfiles/bootstrap.sh
```
That will install zsh, nvm, and the company git hooks. If you prefer nix, ping me and I can share the nix config.

onboard-bot: New hire account created: Eli Martinez. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/eli_martinez. Laptop enrollment: linux-jenkins job queued, ETA ~20m.

Lina (People Ops): Hi Eli  welcome! We've placed a welcome kit on your desk and mailed a sticker pack to your address (tracking 1Z222AA10123456888). Badge request submitted; you can pick up badge at security desk after 2pm. Welcome lunch next Wednesday 12pm.

Diego Vega: hey Eli  I'm on eng-ml too. First-week task is small: add a tiny example to the embeddings-readme so you see the eval infra. Want to pair tomorrow morning?

Eli Martinez: thanks all! Pairing tomorrow sounds great, 10am PT works. One more tiny ask  where do I find internal model benchmarks? Trying to skim docs before pairing.

Maya (IT Support): Eli  for Linux benchmarks we host them in infra/docs/model-benchmarks.md (internal). If the job fails during enrollment, drop the output here or DM me the job ID and I'll SSH in.

Chris (DevEx): added the internal links to your onboarding checklist. I'll drop the small setup checklist in your DM and the zoom for pairing tomorrow. See you at 10am PT :slightly_smiling_face:
